entities.summary: The Georgian Stock Exchange is the principal stock exchange in the country of Georgia. It was created by the "Joint Stock Company Georgian Stock Exchange Charter" which was registered and approved in 1999. It is located in the capital city of Tbilisi and its abbreviation in English is GeSE. The Georgian Stock Exchange is a member of the Federation of Euro-Asian Stock Exchanges.
